title: Complementing Import of Antigen Rapid Test Kits with Local Supply
what_it_is: Complementing Import of Antigen Rapid Test Kits with Local Supply

sections.label: Local ART kit manufacturing support
sections.summary: Applicants said kits will be made locally, and approved companies can apply for MTI grant and loan schemes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The applicants indicated that the kits will be manufactured or assembled locally.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Once approved, the companies will be able to apply for existing grant and loan schemes that MTI and its Statutory Boards provide to support companies with their plans for local manufacturing.

sections.label: No local approved ART kits
sections.summary: No companies locally manufacture or assemble ART kits approved for retail sale yet.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Currently, as I indicated in my answer to the Parliamentary Question (PQ), there are no companies locally manufacturing or assembling ART kits that are approved for retail sale yet.

sections.label: Alltest and Indicaid PSAR approval
sections.summary: Alltest and Indicaid have obtained PSAR approval and will be on retail shelves this month.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The brands, Alltest and Indicaid, have just obtained the Pandemic Special Access Route (PSAR) approval and will soon be on our retail shelves this month.

sections.label: ART kit supply, price, testing centres
sections.summary: MOH and HSA approved 12 ART kits, prices fell by almost half, and testing centres and kits for low-income households were set up.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: If Members remember, in the last one year – we now have a wider supply of ART kits and, as of now, MOH and HSA have already approved 12, with more coming on-stream – the price of test kits has since fallen by almost half.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Having said that, I want to assure Mr Gerald Giam that, indeed, price is one of the considerations as part of MOH and HSA's evaluation criteria.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And I want to assure Singaporeans that, regardless of financial background, if you remember last week, MOH has announced the setting up of more than 200 Combined Testing Centres (CTCs) and Quick Testing Centres (QTCs), where any COVID-19 patient with mild symptoms can proceed to for supervised self-test ART kits usage.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: At the same time, MOH and MSF have also distributed about 140,000 kits to low-income households.

sections.label: ART kit import locations
sections.summary: ART kits are imported from various locations, including South Korea, US, Hong Kong and China.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: In fact, we import from various locations, including South Korea, US, Hong Kong and China.
